verdict.rationale:
Langfuse supports some automatic trigger-action behavior — threshold-based alerts to Slack/GitHub Actions/Webhooks, automatic LLM-as-a-judge scoring on production traces, and CI/CD gating on regressions — which are event-driven automations. However, these are fixed, purpose-built triggers rather than a general user-definable rules engine (no evidence of custom condition/action rule builder covering arbitrary events).

missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/automation builder letting users define arbitrary event conditions and custom actions, independent confirmation these alerting/scoring triggers work reliably in practice.
